title: How Does the Biological Clock Tick?

sentences.en: A Our life span is restricted.
sentences.zh: 我们的寿命是有限的

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Everyone accepts this as ‘biologically’ obvious.
sentences.zh: 所有人都认为这“在生物上”是显而易见的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: ‘Nothing lives forever!’ However, in this statement we think of artificially produced, technical objects, products which are subjected to natural wear and tear during use.
sentences.zh: ”然而,我们在这个声明中想到的是人工制造的技术物品、在使用过程中自然磨损和撕裂的产品。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: This leads to the result that at some time or other the object stops working and is unusable (‘death’ in the biological sense).
sentences.zh: 这导致结果,在某个时候或其它时候,物体停止工作,无法使用(生物意义上的 " 死亡 " )。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But are the wear and tear and loss of function of technical objects and the death of living organisms really similar or comparable?
sentences.zh: 但是技术物体的磨损和功能丧失以及生物体的死亡是否真的相似或相似?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: B Our ‘dead’ products are ‘static’, closed systems.
sentences.zh: B 我们的“死”产品是“静态”、封闭的系统。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It is always the basic material which constitutes the object and which, in the natural course of things, is worn down and becomes ‘older*.
sentences.zh: 构成物体的基本材料在自然过程中总是磨损,成为`老*。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Ageing in this case must occur according to the laws of physical chemistry and of thermodynamics.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下,必须根据物理化学和热力学法则,使老龄化成为现实。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Although the same law holds for a living organism, the result of this law is not inexorable in the same way.
sentences.zh: 虽然同一法律对活体生物体有效力,但该法律的结果并非不可改变。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: At least as long as a biological system has the ability to renew itself it could actually become older without ageing; an organism is an open, dynamic system through which new material continuously flows.
sentences.zh: 至少只要生物系统有能力更新自己,它实际上就可能老化而不会老化;生物体是一个开放的、动态的系统,通过这个系统,新的材料不断流动。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Destruction of old material and formation of new material are thus in permanent dynamic equilibrium.
sentences.zh: 因此,销毁旧材料和形成新材料处于永久动态平衡状态。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The material of which the organism is formed changes continuously.
sentences.zh: 生物体构成的物质不断改变。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Thus our bodies continuously exchange old substance for new, just like a spring which more or less maintains its form and movement, but in which the water molecules are always different.
sentences.zh: 因此我们的身体不断将旧物质换成新的物质, 就像一个或多或少保持其形态和运动的春天, 水分子总是不同的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: It is not, in principle, necessary for a biological system to age and die.
sentences.zh: 原则上,生物系统不必老化和死亡。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, a restricted life span, ageing, and then death are basic characteristics of life.
sentences.zh: 然而,生命期有限、老龄化以及死亡是生命的基本特征。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: The reason for this is easy to recognise: in nature, the existent organisms either adapt or are regularly replaced by new types.
sentences.zh: 原因很容易识别:在自然界,现有的生物不是适应就是经常被新类型取代。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Because of changes in the genetic material (mutations) these have new characteristics and in the course of their individual lives they are tested for optimal or better adaptation to the environmental conditions.
sentences.zh: 由于遗传物质(变异)的变化,这些基因物质具有新的特征,在他们个人生命过程中,它们经过测试,以最佳或更好地适应环境条件。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Immortality would disturb this system – it needs room for new and better life.
sentences.zh: 生命的不朽会扰乱这个系统, 它需要空间来过上新的更好的生活。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This is the basic problem of evolution.
sentences.zh: 这是演化的基本问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: D Every organism has a life span which is highly characteristic.
sentences.zh: 每个生物体的寿命都是高度典型的

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: There are striking differences in life span between different species, but within one species the parameter is relatively constant.
sentences.zh: 不同物种之间的寿命差别很大,但在一个物种中,参数相对稳定。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For example, the average duration of human life has hardly changed in thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 例如,人类生命的平均持续时间在几千年中几乎没有改变。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Although more and more people attain an advanced age as a result of developments in medical care and better nutrition, the characteristic upper limit for most remains 80 years.
sentences.zh: 虽然由于医疗保健和营养改善方面的发展,越来越多的人进入老年,但大多数人的典型上限仍然是80岁。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: A further argument against the simple wear and tear theory is the observation that the time within which organisms age lies between a few days (even a few hours for unicellular organisms) and several thousand years, as with mammoth trees.
sentences.zh: 反对简单的损耗理论的另一个论点是,观察认为生物体年龄从几天(即使是非细胞生物数小时)到几千年(如长毛象树)之间的时间。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: E If a life span is a genetically determined biological characteristic, it is logically necessary to propose the existence of an internal clock, which in some way measures and controls the ageing process and which finally determines death as the last step in a fixed programme.
sentences.zh: E 如果寿命是遗传上确定的生物特征,那么从逻辑上讲,有必要提议设立内部钟,以某种方式衡量和控制老龄化过程,并最终确定死亡是固定方案的最后一步。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Like the life span, the metabolic rate has for different organisms a fixed mathematical relationship to the body mass.
sentences.zh: 与寿命一样,代谢率对不同生物体具有固定的数学关系,与身体质量具有固定的数学关系。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In comparison to the life span this relationship is ‘inverted’: the larger the organism the lower its metabolic rate.
sentences.zh: 与寿命相比,这种关系是“反向的”:生物体越大,代谢率就越低。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Again this relationship is valid not only for birds, but also, similarly on average within the systematic unit, for all other organisms (plants, animals, unicellular organisms).
sentences.zh: 这种关系不仅对鸟类有效,而且对所有其他生物(植物、动物、非卵巢生物)也同样在系统单位内同样有效。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: F Animals which behave ‘frugally’ with energy become particularly old, for example, crocodiles and tortoises.

sentences.en: Animals which save energy by hibernation or lethargy (e.g. bats or hedgehogs) live much longer than those which are always active.
sentences.zh: 动物通过休眠或昏睡(例如蝙蝠或刺绣猪)节省能量,其寿命比那些总是活跃的动物长得多。

sentences.en: The metabolic rate of mice can be reduced by a very low consumption of food (hunger diet).

sentences.en: They then may live twice as long as their well fed comrades.

sentences.en: Women become distinctly (about 10 per cent) older than men.

sentences.en: If you examine the metabolic rates of the two sexes you establish that the higher male metabolic rate roughly accounts for the lower male life span.
sentences.zh: 如果检查了两种性别的代谢率,你就会确定,较高的男性代谢率大致上是男性寿命寿命较短的原因。

sentences.en: That means that they live life ‘energetically’ – more intensively, but not for as long.
sentences.zh: 也就是说他们的生活“从零开始” — — 更密集,但不会持续多久。

sentences.en: Extreme high performance sports may lead to optimal cardiovascular performance, but they quite certainly do not prolong life.
sentences.zh: 极高性能体育可能会导致心血管最佳性能,但肯定不会延长生命。

sentences.en: Relaxation lowers metabolic rate, as does adequate sleep and in general an equable and balanced personality.
